author: VANSMITHLAB
title: FIELD.IO
summary: A studio in London since 2009. It uses computational design, motion and data to create graphic systems, digital products and spaces that change over time.

hero_image.alt: A workbench under an angled lamp holding a small illuminated model box wired to a breadboard, with circuit diagrams and prints spread in front and two people working behind.
hero_image.caption: A responsive space prototyped at desk scale before it is built at room scale.
